description:
Hyperliquid perpetuals: mark and oracle price, 24h change, current hourly funding rate (positive means longs pay shorts) and annualized, open interest in coins and USD, 24h volume and max leverage. Name up to 20 coins, or leave coins out to get the top markets sorted by volume, open interest, funding or 24h move. funding_hours adds hourly funding history for one coin.

$0.001 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

coins.description: Hyperliquid coin names, e.g. ["BTC", "ETH", "kPEPE"]. Leave out for the top markets.

funding_hours.description: Add hourly funding history for this many hours; needs exactly one coin.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

sort.description: How to rank the top markets when coins is left out (default volume).

name: perps_market
title: Perps market (Hyperliquid)
